text: {"purpose":"CBACT04C processes a transaction‑category balance file, updates each account’s balance with accrued interest, and records the resulting transactions in a new file. It reads account and cross‑reference data to determine account groups and interest rates, then writes detailed transaction records for each balance entry. The program runs as a batch job, handling all I/O and error conditions before terminating.","inputs":["TCATBAL-FILE","XREF-FILE","ACCOUNT-FILE","DISCGRP-FILE"],"outputs":["TRANSACT-FILE"],"side_effects":["Updates balances in ACCOUNT-FILE","Writes transaction records to TRANSACT-FILE","Logs errors and aborts on critical I/O failures"],"role":"batch","error_handling":"On any file I/O error the program displays an error message, sets IO-STATUS, calls the ABEND routine CEE3ABD with an error code, and exits. Normal EOF conditions are handled gracefully by setting END-OF-FILE and completing the loop.","evidence":[{"line_start":180,"line_end":222,"claim":"Main processing loop reads TCATBAL-FILE, updates account balances, and writes transaction records."},{"line_start":350,"line_end":370,"claim":"Procedure 1050-UPDATE-ACCOUNT updates the account record with accrued interest and rewrites it to ACCOUNT-FILE."},{"line_start":470,"line_end":515,"claim":"Procedure 1300-B-WRITE-TX constructs and writes a transaction record to TRANSACT-FILE."}]}
